Class TeamPoses

java.lang.Object
org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode.teamPedroPathing.TeamPoses
public class TeamPoses extends Object
Define all the team's Poses here. The Poses should be either for RED or BLUE, and the canonicalColor set accordingly.
